description: Supported on-disk storage schema versions. Latest matches storage_migration::SCHEMA_TIMELOCK_DEFAULTS. Add new version by appending and regenerating fixtures.

changelog.1: Genesis schema. Registry: Talos, PatronUpdate, NameRecord, TalosName, CreatorOf. Governance: GovernanceBundle (no TimelockConfig).
changelog.2: Added explicit TimelockConfig to GovernanceBundle. Additive: metadata field on Talos (Option<String>).
changelog.3: TalosGovernance v1.1.0: adds DataKey::QuorumReached(u32) idempotency sentinel. Written once when a proposal first crosses the quorum threshold. Purely additive — existing keys and entry-points are unchanged. Companion EventQuorumReached (topic: qrm_rchd) is emitted at most once per proposal.
